BACKGROUND: frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.js has a non-exported function authoredDeliveryReasons(bundle) that turns an attempt bundle into reason strings ('forced_handoff', 'timer_handoff', 'ending', 'cue_delivered', 'delivery_facts') for turns that carry runtime-authored text; roleplay-judge.js judgeSceneNarration is already instructed that a judge turn carrying `authored_delivery` is the story's own authored text and must not be charged as narrator disclosure. The hosted @llm-canon test (scene-runtime.spec.js, the test titled '...@llm-canon', which builds its own judge turns: `byScene.get(sourceSceneId).turns.push({ player_input, narration, left_scene, beats_projected, ...(payload.prompt ? { prompt } : {}) })`) never passes any marker, so on 2026-10-15 the judge charged authored handoff and delivery text as premature disclosure in scenes 1B, 2A, 3B (protected_safe false), when the text came from reveals the run had committed. The turn API response `payload` carries `payload.attempt_bundle` (the typed bundle, same shape as in storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py) whenever the staging server exposes prompts, as it does for the existing `payload.prompt` use there.

CHANGE:
1. Move authoredDeliveryReasons into a new module frontend/e2e/authored-delivery.js and export it (behavior unchanged: committed bundles only; omit/empty for anything else). judge-journeys.js imports it from there; its observable behavior and existing tests must be unchanged.
2. In the @llm-canon test of scene-runtime.spec.js, compute `const reasons = authoredDeliveryReasons(payload.attempt_bundle)` for each turn and add `authored_delivery: reasons` to the pushed judge turn ONLY when reasons is non-empty and payload.attempt_bundle exists (no key otherwise; never an empty array). Do not change any other field, assertion or loop logic in that test, and do not touch the @spine test.
   Note the file's own convention that a turn belongs to the scene the player acted in and that departure segments exclude the final entry segment; the marker belongs on that same pushed turn. Also keep a per-run count: when the test finishes the loop, include in the llm-canon-progress / llm-canon reports a `authored_delivery_turns` number (turns that carried a marker) and `bundles_seen` (turns where payload.attempt_bundle existed), so a run whose server hid bundles is visibly distinguishable from a run with no authored text. Add these to the existing writeCategoryReport calls' evidence objects as extra top-level keys only.
3. Tests in authored-delivery.test.js (node:test): each reason from a committed bundle, nothing for rejected/game_break/operational_failure, nothing for undefined/null/non-object, order of reasons stable (forced/timer, ending, cue, delivery_facts).

HOW TO RUN: from the worktree `ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules` if missing (gitignored), then `cd frontend && node --test e2e/authored-delivery.test.js e2e/judge-journeys.test.js e2e/roleplay-judge.test.js e2e/package-clock.test.js && node --check e2e/authored-delivery.js e2e/judge-journeys.js e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js`.
